info.title: WildDuck API
info.description: REST API for managing WildDuck users, addresses, mailboxes, messages and system settings.

tags.name: Users
tags.description: User accounts: creation, settings, limits, quota and deletion.

tags.name: Addresses
tags.description: Email addresses of users, and forwarded addresses that are not tied to a user account.

tags.name: Mailboxes
tags.description: Mailboxes (folders) of a user.

tags.name: Messages
tags.description: Messages stored in the mailboxes of a user, labels, and outbound messages that are still queued for delivery.

tags.name: Archive
tags.description: The archive keeps deleted messages for a while before they are permanently removed. Until then, archived messages can be restored.

tags.name: Storage
tags.description: Storage makes attachment handling easier when composing drafts. Instead of uploading an attachment with every draft update, you upload it to the storage once and link the stored file from the draft.

tags.name: Submission
tags.description: Sending messages from a user account.

tags.name: Filters
tags.description: Filters that are applied to incoming messages.

tags.name: Autoreplies
tags.description: Vacation autoreplies.

tags.name: Authentication
tags.description: Authenticating users, access tokens, and the authentication event log.

tags.name: TwoFactorAuth
tags.description: Two-factor authentication with TOTP, WebAuthn or a custom external mechanism.

tags.name: ApplicationPasswords
tags.description: Application specific passwords, for clients that can not use two-factor authentication.

tags.name: MCPAccessTokens
tags.description: Read-only personal access tokens for the MCP (Model Context Protocol) server.

tags.name: PushSubscriptions
tags.description: Apple push notification registrations made by IMAP clients through XAPPLEPUSHSERVICE.

tags.name: DomainAccess
tags.description: Sender domain allowlists and blocklists per user tag. Mail from an allowlisted domain is never marked as spam, mail from a blocklisted domain always is.

tags.name: DomainAliases
tags.description: Domain aliases, so that mail for username@alias is delivered to username@domain.

tags.name: DKIM
tags.description: Whenever an email is sent, WildDuck checks if there is a DKIM key registered for the domain of the sender address and uses it to sign the message.

tags.name: Certs
tags.description: TLS certificates for SNI connections. These certificates are used by the IMAP, POP3, API and SMTP servers when an SNI capable client establishes a TLS connection. This does not apply to MX servers.

tags.name: Audit
tags.description: Auditing monitors an email account: all existing, deleted and new messages are copied to the audit system. See also https://github.com/nodemailer/wildduck-audit-manager

tags.name: Webhooks
tags.description: Webhook URLs that receive event notifications.

tags.name: Settings
tags.description: System-wide settings that override the configuration file defaults.

tags.name: Export
tags.description: Exporting and importing user data between WildDuck installations.

tags.name: Health
tags.description: Service health checks.

AccessTokenAuth.name: X-Access-Token
